definition.content:
## P1-P5 escalation

- **P1** fraud-detection, ledger-bronze-silver-gold -> page platform team, ack 15 min
- **P2** aml-nightly-scoring -> page risk team, ack 30 min
- **P3** risk-month-end-report -> ticket, next business day
- **P4** marketing-aggregates -> ticket, best effort

Full matrix: docs/p1-p5-severity-matrix.md
